message.reasoning_content:
Probe t7 confirms errors ~3 in all three cases (partial k blocks, total divisible by 32). These are large max abs errors (values ~ randn*... with 64-dim, magnitudes ~1) — errors of 3+ clearly not float noise. Confirm claim c1 and record verdict reject.

One concern: errors that large could partly come from query side partial block handling (EVEN_SEQ_QBLOCK is computed per-seq correctly, so fine). Also note error affects rows across whole sequences, not just boundary — expected because softmax over extra keys shifts everything. Good enough.

Finalize evidence, update claim status, record verdict.
